advisor.title: Advisor
advisor.description: Who should attend which session: overbooked sessions, people with missing or expired training, and a plan you can tune and save.

settings.title: Calculator
settings.description: Every number below feeds the ranking. Changes apply instantly.

weightExpired.label: Expired training
weightExpired.help: Base priority for a training that has expired.

weightMissing.label: Never completed
weightMissing.help: Base priority for a required training never taken.

weightExpiring.label: Expiring soon
weightExpiring.help: Base priority for a training about to expire.

expiringRamp.label: Urgency ramp
expiringRamp.help: Extra priority for each day an expiring training is closer to its date.

waitPenalty.label: Waiting cost
waitPenalty.help: Points lost for each day until the session; favours sooner dates.

lateAfterExpiryPenalty.label: Late after expiry
lateAfterExpiryPenalty.help: Points lost when the session is after the training expires.

fillPreference.label: Fill preference
fillPreference.help: Positive fills sessions that are already busy; negative spreads people out.

maxFill.label: Plan up to
maxFill.help: Seats kept free in every session, as a share of capacity.

horizonDays.label: Look ahead
horizonDays.help: Sessions further out are not used.

maxPerEmployee.label: Per person
maxPerEmployee.help: Most sessions one person is planned into.

formula.title: How suggestions are ranked
formula.priority: Each open training gets a priority: expired {expired}, never completed {missing}, expiring {expiring} plus {ramp} per day closer to expiry (within {window} days).
formula.order: People are served in priority order; ties go to the more urgent status, then the sooner expiry, then department and name.
formula.score: Each gets the best-scoring session with a free seat: priority − {wait} per day of waiting − {late} if it starts after the training expires + {fill} × how full the session would be.
formula.limits: Sessions are planned up to {maxFill} % of capacity, within {horizon} days, at most {perPerson} per person, never at overlapping times.
formula.overbooking: Overbooked sessions first move their unnamed seats to other sessions of the same course; those seats are not offered to the plan.
formula.note: Same data and settings always give the same plan. Open a row in the plan to see its score term by term.
